needed.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: obstruction by parked vehicles and other items on the footway
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the footway is clear for pedestrian use.

needed.evidence: uneven and broken sections on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and resurface the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: marked crossing without refuge on a wide road
needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: crossing is hard to see and obstructed
needed.suggestion: Improve visibility of the crossing with better markings and signage, and ensure it is not obstructed by vehicles or other items.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate safe pedestrian access.
